from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data from a single company's report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company in the financial report")
    notes_receivable_balance: float = Field(description="Ending balance of Notes Receivable (应收票据)")
    reporting_period: str = Field(description="The financial reporting period (e.g., Q1 2024)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    records: list[CompanyRecord]
